# Support

Use GitHub issues for reproducible bugs, scoped feature requests, and documentation problems.

Before opening an issue, check the README, current state, roadmap, and existing issues. Include the commit or version you are using and a minimal safe reproduction when possible.

Do not use public issues for security vulnerabilities, credentials, private account data, or sensitive broker responses. Follow `SECURITY.md` for private security reporting.

The project is under active development and does not promise compatibility support for every historical commit or evidence schema. Real-money trading support is out of scope.
